input.command: ls graphify-out | head; graphify query "files that import or use Dialog from packages/ui/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx" 2>&1 | head -40

rg -l --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' -e 'from ["'"'"'][^"'"'"']*(ui/components/dialog(/index|/Dialog)?|/dialog/Dialog|/dialog)["'"'"']' . | sort > /tmp/cand.txt
python3 -I - <<'E'
import re
for f in open('/tmp/cand.txt').read().split():
    s=open(f).read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'import\s+(type\s+)?\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']',s):
        p=m.group(3)
        if not re.search(r'(ui/components/dialog(/index|/Dialog)?|/dialog/Dialog|/dialog)$',p): continue
        names=[n.strip().split(' as ')[0].strip() for n in m.group(2).split(',')]
        if 'Dialog' in names: print(f,p,bool(re.search(r'<Dialog[\s>]|Dialog\(',s)))
E
rg -l 'dialog/Dialog"|components/dialog"' --glob '*.{ts,tsx,mdx}' . 2>/dev/null | head -0; ls /tmp/cand.txt >/dev/null

rg -n 'from "\./Dialog"|from "\.\./Dialog"|/Dialog"' --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' . | head; echo ---; head -20 packages/ui/components/dialog/dialog.test.tsx | rg import; echo ---; rg -n 'ui/dialog' packages/platform/atoms/connect/apple/AppleConnect.tsx packages/platform/atoms/create-schedule/wrappers/CreateSchedulePlatformWrapper.tsx; ls packages/platform/atoms/components/ui | rg -i dialog; echo ---; rg -l 'vi.mock\(.*components/dialog' --glob '!graphify-out' --glob '!node_modules' .

rg -n -B1 -A8 'components/dialog' apps/web/modules/bookings/components/OverlayCalendar/OverlayCalendarContinueModal.test.tsx packages/platform/atoms/event-types/__tests__/EventTypeListItem.test.tsx | head -50; rg -n 'Dialog' packages/platform/atoms/event-types/components/EventTypeListItem.tsx | head -5; rg -n 'Dialog' packages/ui/components/command/Command.tsx | head -4

content.text:
I've finished the search and am assembling the final list now.

`Dialog` is a Radix-style wrapper exported from `packages/ui/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx`. It's re-exported through `packages/ui/components/dialog/index.ts`, so most callers import it as `@calcom/ui/components/dialog`.

I counted a file only if it imports the `Dialog` symbol from that module, directly or via the index, and uses it. I left out these look-alikes:
- `@coss/ui/components/dialog` (used by `TravelScheduleModal.tsx`) and `packages/coss-ui/src/components/dialog.tsx` are a separate component set.
- `@/components/ui/dialog` (used by two `packages/platform/atoms` files) is a separate local alias. I didn't trace where it resolves.
- Many files import only `DialogContent`, `DialogFooter` or `ConfirmationDialogContent`. They don't use `Dialog` itself, so I excluded them.

I read the pattern-matched matches by script rather than every file. Two judgement calls:
- `EventTypeListItem.test.tsx` is included because it mocks `Dialog` for a component that uses it.
- `Dialog.docs.mdx` is included because it renders `Dialog`.

The graph query was too truncated to be complete, so I used `rg` to get exact matches.
